async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the admin dashboard to start from a known page
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/dashboard/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # From the dashboard, navigate to the sales orders page
    await page.goto('/index.php/admin/sales/order/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # On the Orders page, filter for pending orders
    # Look for a status filter combobox or filters button
    status_filter = page.get_by_role('combobox').filter(has_text='Status')
    if await status_filter.count() > 0:
        await status_filter.select_option('Pending')
    else:
        # Alternative: open filters and select status
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Filters').click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('Pending')
        await page.get_by_role('button', name='Apply Filters').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Check if there are any pending orders
    order_rows = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell').filter(has_text='Pending'))
    if await order_rows.count() == 0:
        return 'No pending orders found.'
    # Get the first row (most recent pending order)
    first_order_row = order_rows.first
    # Extract order ID and purchase date from this row
    order_id_link = first_order_row.get_by_role('link').first
    order_id = await order_id_link.text_content()
    # Assuming purchase date is in a specific column, adjust index as needed
    purchase_date_cell = first_order_row.get_by_role('cell').nth(3)
    purchase_date = await purchase_date_cell.text_content()
    # Return the result as a string
    return f'Order ID: {order_id}, Purchase Date: {purchase_date}'
